sources.title: sb3/ppo-BreakoutNoFrameskip-v4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a PPO agent playing BreakoutNoFrameskip-v4 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
